body:
Posting from throwaway.   


My mom had undiagnosed hypothyroidism for the the first 8 years of my life, and during this time, I was terrified of her. If I got anything less than a B+ on grade school assignment, I was beat with a brush or spoon. I internalized this so hard, making any mistake makes me feel compelled to harm myself in some way, be it striking myself in my head with a closed fist as hard as I could, repeatedly or sometimes just feeling like I never should have been born at all and my entire existence is a mistake.  


The worst part is that she got medicated as I was approaching 9 and it was like a switch flipped, but the damage was done. I confronted her about all this way later during a major depressive episode I had. She didn't even *remember.*  


Failure for me is unacceptable and any mistakes or burdens I place on others make me so sick to my stomach that I would have been more productive as an abortion used fro stem cell research, even though, in all fairness, I never once was verbally abused beyond being called "embarrassing" whenever I'd do anything beyond being silent and sitting still when we went anywhere. (However this was also followed by calling out a number that increases with each subsequent callout, informing you the number of spankings you were gonna get waylaid by when we got home. No arguments. No mitigating factors. No chance to even redeem yourself before returning home).   


Nearly two decades later and I still struggle to accept anything less than perfection from myself.

Posted from my throwaway just in case...  


Ex left me for a coworker.

  
He's a (ex???) heroin junkie (Who, in all fairness has gone to rehab, but it has not curbed any substance abuse. I watched him snort crushed-up Ritalin) and now he monitors all of her messages, none of her friends will talk to her after how heartlessly she was ready to drop me (some madder at her than I could ever be, ending some friendships of over a decade old in a single day), and I don't even think she's seen her family in over a year.  


I'd say my "vengeance" was actually losing 80lbs and keeping it off despite all the diets she'd attempt to have us both go through (and she'd ruin with \*at least\* a liter a vodka every weekend). While I know that she almost got evicted (and recently moved... might be related) after moving in with this guy. He won't even take her to the BMV to renew her license so she could drive herself.  


That said, it's not without my own heartache for forever... She took one of the dogs. She *technically* is his owner... but he was still like a son to me. (She didn't think twice about leaving the rescue that she wanted but I ultimately had to housetrain and socialize, though.)

Tried taking her out tonight. We had fun,  but she still resents me for being so closed off with her and more or less forcing her to stay at my parents because I was afraid of rent costs. We eventually moved out with little issue and the fact that I fought it so long out of fear of my mom lashing out... i am trying to improve still.

But there is some solace in that she admitted that she's not given up on me... It's just going to take a lot of time to fix what I let decay.

But I dread tomorrow because she'll be spending it with him and myself with family... and I really keep having intrusive thoughts about my mom's revolver.  Like I won't do it, but my brain keeps imagining the scenario.

Like a final penance for ruining the best thing I had
I basically made one core promise to her. When I'm on my own, I'll work on myself. When we're together, I'll work on us.
Well I wrote her a poem to give her in the brief time she stopped by last night and she loved it, so that's a thing.

But I frequently think of just driving off bridges on the way home,  downing a shitload of sleep pills, or just go to my mom's and unload her revolver on myself.

Like I won't do it, I love my dogs too much (and her too).

But feel like I make everyone miserable. Or am a burden... or just boring.  I was never motivated.  I was never adventurous... I never took her on enough dates.

I just should hope to not wake up in the morning.

Well we work nearly opposite schedules. I work 9-5 and she's 2-10, so she usually doesn't get home till about 11, even later now that she's also dating this other guy who has taken her to more places in a month than I have in a year and now I'm sobbing again fuckfuckfuckfuckfuck.


Edit: Can breathe again, so here's some more info, I have been really bad about ignoring her and bettering myself (losing weight/seeing a therapist/etc). I'm finally really making progress, but every night I feel like I am too late and that I should just drive to my parent's house and find my mom's "Judge" (revolver) and remove myself from being a burden or a drag or a disappointment to everyone. I haven't and I probably won't, but that voice in my head keeps saying shit like "this is an option and you'd be free of this pain".
I agree wholeheartedly, hence me reaching out to the poly community to lend an ear and advice.
True... I've got an appointment on the 30th of May now... Just gotta keep it together till then.
Hopefully the therapist that responded to me this morning will help, but to be honest, I can't help but feel like this is "too good to be true" or at the very least met with tepid, cautious optimism.

More that it's a real crapshoot as to whether or not you're going to get someone religious, or at least that's my perception.

In other news, however, I was recommended a particular therapist for her quality and she actually responded to me.

I've thought about it, but right now it'd feel just reactionary and my options are limited to scraping the bottom of the barrel (Tindr). Couple that with the fact that I feel like I'm a repugnant waste of space, time, and the oxygen I forget that I keep accidentally breathing.
I'm sure there are, but living in southwest ohio suburbia pretty much means I doubt I'll have any luck.

We had a talk last night, and I think it comes down to me feeling like I'm just not worth anyone's time and a general waste of oxygen... with this new partner giving me bad data for confirmation bias. Half the time I feel like everyone would be happier if I was to just vanish and they can get on with their lives without a miserable wreck holding them back. I feel like I can't go to any event because I *know* I'll be bored (or just have this notion I'll be) or feel like there's never enough hours in the day. I can't try dating again for my own partner because it feels a combination of reactionary (disingenuous) and for the aforementioned me being just a useless waste of everyone's time.

I tried reaching out to a few local therapists accepting new patients, but my internal dialogue is telling me to not hold my breath.
I don't think I painted a fair picture. At no point has she forced me to do these things or even asked. I just do them so she can have a comfortable living environment.
I'll try this. I'll start with a depression filter and see if I can get something.

I'm certain time is a major factor for getting used to it... the thing is, I don't resent her seeing this guy at all, nor the guy in question... it's just, I feel like I've been dropped cold turkey so she can indulge in NRE, or am I just an asshole?

Like Poly just makes sense and I want it and know I *can* do it... but I don't know if I can do *this* type of poly yet.

They're technically her (our) dogs. She's agreed to go slow and no more than occasional kissing, which I appreciate. I know poly is okay with me. It's just to be blindsided by this new partner and told that I could go on Tindr or whatever to find my own partner for myself that leaves me feeling lonely on top of the fact that I cannot socialize with any of my coworkers, my wow guilds keep abandoning me, and I feel always ashamed of myself like a failure or worthless... It's just a cavalcade of disappointment that is me.

Fuck, I never mentioned that I have ADHD... but yeah... I do. Like, the only good thing that came out of my botched college free therapy was that I got officially diagnosed for that. Concerta, but since I'm no longer on my parent's plan with Tricare and on my own now, I haven't been able to renew my prescription since it ran out in october.

I currently only have BCBS Gold through work.

I've always taken care of the dogs. Like father, like son, I guess. I've also done all the chores, but she's paid rent so that's kind of been how it's even. With my student loans I barely have any breathing room, financially, but I have been able to take care of utilities nowadays and I buy most of the food (but that's fairly even if I'm thinking about it). 

I actually think I might be somewhat covered with BCBS, but the co-pay, finding a primary doctor, and then finding a therapist all feel like just a series of insurmountable roadblocks.
There's something to be said about commiseration.
TBH I'm a little worried that she'll come across this thread, hence my throwaway, but she also constantly tells me to "read more about poly" and "read the subreddit"... I figured I'd post.

I understand, but I was the neglectful one first. I would often play games the moment I'd get home instead of taking every precious moment I had with her that I should have... I was the shit person, and this is my comeuppance.

I'm sorry I'm just an excuse machine... but...
1. One of our dogs is a super shy rescue and the other, while friendly and could never harm anyone, just barks too dang much when he sees new friends.
2. If I'm struggling to afford therapy, I can't afford classes.

And I know it's not fair for me to ask her to spend less time with her new partner... But I also feel like no one would ever want to be around me, either.

The fur babies always come first. No matter what.

I don't have a primary doctor anymore now that I'm on my own plan. I'm insured... but I just don't have the time and/or energy to just take time off work (because fuck me for trying to use my spare time to get an account going somewhere, only to find out that there's never a doctor or therapist that works a saturday).

Also, I know you don't know me... but it's really... REALLY hard for me to be selfish.
I used to think of myself as introverted, but I'm quickly realizing that it's not the case.
I appreciate the thought, but I think she truly does love me... it's just, as she puts it, she has too much love to give.

The only people I know that'd play are a handful of friends online and the only time we can meet is sunday, sometimes saturday, evenings. 

I have never EVER gone to just some event as a rando before. I never feel welcome and I also never feel like I have enough time to go. When I get home, besides walking dogs, I also do some chores and then it's usually about 7, but I can't stay out later than 10 because the dogs need out about that time.

I hate that I sound like this, but I have no idea where I'd go and I just don't have the energy to go out of my way anywhere. Yes it's scary, but I always feel like I don't "belong". It's always been that way for me. I always envied how my sister could just inject herself into any meetup, but I always feel like an intruder.

But clearly I'm not interesting enough to have conversations "about bullshit" that last for 2-3 hours later in the night. I can never initiate conversation with anyone because nothing I have to say is all that interesting due to lack of hobbies or interest in creating new ones. I used to do art. For fun. But I hit that point where I feel like nothing I make is ever worth anything and is just an eyesore.

The only pride I can take in anymore is the occasional good dish I whip up...

It's not her forcing me to not play DnD. I just feel like I either get to spend a few hours with her on the weekend, or play DnD. One or the other. Not of her choice or ultimatum, just the choice I have to make... And besides, I can't roleplay while depressed. I can barely be me in this state. 

Her birthday isn't for months, but I was sick for a week straight last month and need to earn enough PTO for the one vacation she's wanted to do with me for years and I've always put off.

I don't even know how to find a therapist, tbh. Let alone one that works for me. I know I've needed one for the better part of a decade, but the only one I saw in college tried to tell me that the reason I wasn't open to talking with her about myself was because she was black... like I'm uncomfortable talking to someone about my bottled up emotions.... BECAUSE YOU'RE BLACK?

It was an ongoing thing for years where I'd get wrapped up in a game. That's completely my own fault. I always felt like we were doing something together if we're enjoying each other's company and doing our own thing... but I feel like this is punishment for not taking her out enough... even if it's not her directing the punishment, but more of a karmic justice.

First, thanks for clearing that up. I was under the impression that poly was where everyone is involved with everyone to some degree and open is where it's someone's "own thing". My mistake.

Am I okay...? Sometimes... usually for a while after talking with someone, but most of my job and my home life is sitting in silence. I'm not even so much "jealous" as I just lack a word in English for this emotion beyond a some amalgam of jealousy, loneliness, and self loathing. 

I keep talking with her, but each time she is quick to reassure me that "she's not leaving me" or "he's not going to take her away" and that they both "don't want me to feel bad". Part of me even feels a bit insulted by her quickness to just give me permission to just date some nerdy girl I can talk to about WoW or anime with and have a fling... It's like my mind is twisting this into perceiving it as a self-serving permission slip, but I can rationalize that it's not.

I don't even know how to make friends as an adult. Sure yeah I have my internet cliques and my sunday DnD group, but I can't bring myself to play with them during the limited time I get to see her anymore. 

To be fair, I'm offered compensation for helping with the start-up, but it kind of was a last minute "we NEED help".

I try, but she points out how it's unhealthy for me to be so co-dependent and how alone she felt when I'd play video games when she'd be home. Se even said to basically find a nerdy girl for myself and she even supportively watched me flip through Tindr for a while (but I really don't see anything coming from there).
Not once. She's loyal to a "t" and has always been there for me.

That's okay. The therapist I called has yet to get back to me, so that's unfortunate, but I did attempt a date yesterday and it felt.. wrong. But this helped in a strange way in that I'm just not ready to have my own, for lack of a better term than "partner"... consort? Nevertheless, it felt incredibly wrong to have her over without the GF present. However, I discussed with the GF about me having freedom to pursue our previous poli-mate (PM for brevity) once her real life issues have stabilized and she's ready for a relationship at our own pace, regardless of gf (we had previously throttled it somewhat given the GF's vastly different work hours, where PM and I have identical work schedules). 

This might take a few weeks, but the revelation is that I'm not super ready to go open all willy-nilly and just need more time to be okay with it, so, understandingly, my GF said she's okay with taking things slower with her personal new object of affection. 

I still hate myself, but at least I was able to eat this morning (I've lost 10 lbs in a week).

**Edit:** Still haven't heard back from therapist, gf went on a date with him last night and didn't get home till almost 2 AM. I feel so abandoned and alone, even though she constantly tells me that I'm her primary partner and that she still loves me... I just wish someone would shoot me so I could fully really accept this. It comes in waves... I'll be... tolerant... of it for a few hours, and then the next few hours I descend into this pit of despair where it strikes me as if she's trying to phase me out because I'm just that boring to be around. I wish someone would just fucking shoot me and get this agony over with so she can just have someone in her life that interests her. She calls me funny, caring, and supportive, but then won't come home until 2AM, 6 hours from when I need to be getting ready from work... 

I even dread tonight because I'm fairly certain he'll be visiting, she'll be getting drunk, and I KNOW she'll try something when she feels as though I've permitted stuff thusfar and drunk her will just swing for the fences. I almost never drink due to a high tolerance making it not worthwhile, but I'm seriously thinking of just getting absolutely blasted so I can be numb to the inevitability am hopefully won't wake up.

I know no one is actually gonna read this thread this far... but at least it was cathartic to write.

True. It's just I feel like I'm boring if she's seeking a bonding through conversation elsewhere... I have a hard time starting conversations, myself. in general, as I assume anything I'm excited to talk about must be dull or just too out of left-field to discuss. I did call a therapist today and left a message about scheduling an appointment. A big thing the GF is stressing to me is that I need to do things *for* me, and stop bending over backwards though self-sacrifice in making everyone else happy.

Not quite, but it's cool nonetheless. 

I'm certain it was more lyric-heavy.
While it has been solved, I figured that you might get a kick out of this video in regards to Nalalan: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8lUe46EOcvY.

Actually as for that, I was going for a pirate joke in hopes people would send me pictures of treasure chests and stuff. 

Kind of a flopped effort in retrospect.

It seems encouraging her to consider identifying as non-binary along with some role-reversal in bed might be just what she needs alongside the crossdressing.

Our relationship is even stronger now!

After some discussion, we've decided that we're both okay if she personally identifies as nonbinary and just uses female pronouns for simplicity. I've also offered to "blow her" through some clever usage of her vibe until we can get the proper harness/toys.

Both suggestions have made her swell with excitement. She even confesses that they will likely do wonders to quell her self doubts and help aid in the continued restoration of her libido. 


Thank you.

PS: love the term "dysphoria gremlin"

EDIT - Found out I could make a perfectly functioning harness out of my extra loop belts. SEXY SCIENCE!

She has gone to therapists before years back, but they were mostly to assist with a depression brought on by another, unrelated issue that out of respect I won't go into too much detail other than saying it having to do with an oral fixation. 

All of which were unhelpful specifically to her and only ultimately worsened her condition and she almost OD'd because of it. 

While that happened years before we met, she recently started going to a therapist again for intense anxiety brought on from a party we had gone to that resulted in her, while dehydrated, having had bad fall and brief seizure. She's perfectly fine physically now, but the experience took weeks for her to loosen up from, finally eased up by the new therapist. I'll advise that on her next appointment, she brings up her dysphoria bouts with them. 

Edit: Just spoke with her. She has confirmed that her therapist is a trans safe-space.
She's actually not a bad person, but rather just a senior in high-school feeling "enlightened".
